title: MURAD: A Large-Scale Multi-Domain Unified Reverse Arabic Dictionary Dataset
findings: The primary finding is the creation of the MURAD dataset, which includes a diverse, multi-domain collection of Arabic word-definition pairs. A significant finding related to religion is that 18.57% of this dataset (17,874 entries) is dedicated to Islamic terminology, thereby preserving and making computationally accessible the cultural and religious vocabulary integral to the Arabic language.

measurement_description: The paper introduces the MURAD dataset, a large-scale Arabic reverse dictionary. Its faith-related component involves the inclusion and formal definition of a substantial corpus of terminology from Islamic studies, including Islamic jurisprudence (Fiqh) and creed (Aqidah).
